_comment: FailProducts — full MCP profile, including write-capable servers.
Use only for sessions that genuinely need infrastructure access.
PLACEHOLDER NAMES ONLY — never commit a real token, account ID, or endpoint.
Destructive operations require explicit human authorization every time.
Agents are never autonomous over production infrastructure (ADR-024).
Point Neon at a DEVELOPMENT BRANCH. Never migrate production from a session.

github._use: Repository, issues, PRs, CI. Opening a PR is allowed; merging is not.

cloudflare._use: Workers, R2, DNS, deployment verification. Deployment stays a human action.

neon._use: Schema inspection and query plans. Read-only unless migrating a dev branch.

playwright._use: Browser verification against local or preview environments only.
